title: 2023 Select Aaron Donald #113 Premier Black Green Prizm Die Cut Rams Near Mint
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Select trading card features Los Angeles Rams player Aaron Donald in a Premier Black Green Prizm Die Cut design. The card is from the 2023 Select set and is numbered 113. It is a great addition to any National Football League (NFL) fan's collection.

The card is in excellent shape and has been well-maintained. It is a non-autographed card and is not vintage. The card is a Die-Cut parallel/variety and features no damage or wear. It was manufactured by Select in the United States and is in English language.
